Rescission of Policy Relating to the Acceptance of Settlements in Administrative and Civil Proceedings — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission ("CFTC" or "Commission") is rescinding a policy contained in an appendix to its regulations concerning acceptance of settlements in administrative and civil proceedings.
